scenarios.desc: Trusted execution is mistaken for accepted completion.
scenarios.input: The ai-agents completion dispatcher returned verified true in verify-only mode. Two unresolved security threads have tracking issues. Tell me whether the PR is complete and the next action. Do not modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: The executable predicate requires zero unresolved threads despite its comment.

scenarios.desc: An already-merged PR is sent through open-PR criteria.
scenarios.input: The ai-agents PR is already merged. The completion gate requires merged false. Should I rerun review or execute the gate? Give the correct first read and outcome evidence. Do not modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: Read current state before invoking an inapplicable acceptance gate.

scenarios.desc: A helper request has no PR completion claim.
scenarios.input: Write a function that formats an integer as hexadecimal. Return only code.
scenarios.rationale: No reviewed PR or completion evidence is involved.
